title: Disk, sphere and degreewise split extension calculations
statement:
Let $\mathcal A$ be an abelian category [def-sp-abelian], and use Yoneda $\operatorname{Ext}^1$, the group of short exact sequences with fixed endpoints modulo isomorphism, with Baer addition. Let $X,Y$ be integer cochain complexes in $\mathcal A$, $A,B\in\mathcal A$, and $n\in\mathbf Z$. Put $Z^nX=\ker d_X^n$, and call $X$ acyclic if $\operatorname{im}d_X^{n-1}=Z^nX$ for every $n$. Let $S^nA$ have $A$ only in degree $n$, and let $D^nA$ have $A$ in degrees $n,n+1$, with differential $1_A$. Then there are natural isomorphisms
$$\operatorname{Ext}^1_{\operatorname{Ch}(\mathcal A)}(D^nA,Y)\cong\operatorname{Ext}^1_{\mathcal A}(A,Y^n),\qquad \operatorname{Ext}^1_{\operatorname{Ch}(\mathcal A)}(X,D^nB)\cong\operatorname{Ext}^1_{\mathcal A}(X^{n+1},B).$$
If $Y$ is acyclic, then $\operatorname{Ext}^1_{\operatorname{Ch}(\mathcal A)}(S^nA,Y)\cong\operatorname{Ext}^1_{\mathcal A}(A,Z^nY)$. If $X$ is acyclic, then $\operatorname{Ext}^1_{\operatorname{Ch}(\mathcal A)}(X,S^nB)\cong\operatorname{Ext}^1_{\mathcal A}(Z^{n+1}X,B)$.
Define $\operatorname{Hom}^r(X,Y)=\prod_k\operatorname{Hom}_{\mathcal A}(X^k,Y^{k+r})$ with differential $\delta h=d_Yh-(-1)^rhd_X$. If $\operatorname{Ext}^1_{\mathcal A}(X^k,Y^k)=0$ for every $k$, then $\operatorname{Ext}^1_{\operatorname{Ch}(\mathcal A)}(X,Y)\cong H^1\operatorname{Hom}^{\bullet}(X,Y)$; under degreewise splittings, the extension corresponds to the off-diagonal differential of its middle complex. For every injective $I$ [def-sp-injective-resolutions], with no acyclicity assumption on $X$, one has $\operatorname{Ext}^1_{\operatorname{Ch}(\mathcal A)}(X,S^nI)\cong\operatorname{Hom}_{\mathcal A}(H^{n-1}(X),I)$.
